purpose: Visualization only. These 320 sampled time positions are not audio, cannot reconstruct the full WAV, and cannot reproduce the constrained native-query search.
compression: Nearest time-position samples on one shared 320-point grid; no averaging, no inference.
raw_direction_formula: radius * B @ coefficients, followed by waveform feasibility projection. Sampled basis combinations alone do not equal final constrained delta.
native_distance_definition: Model-specific squared donor distance, normalized to the clean-to-donor squared distance. Not a human identity score or success probability.

frequency_weights.low: 1 up to 1000 Hz, linearly decreases to 0 from 1000 to 2000 Hz
frequency_weights.high: 0 up to 3500 Hz, linearly increases to 1 from 3500 to 4500 Hz; 1 up to Nyquist
